label: Report
description: A news report is a shorter story about events with immediate relevance, written from a detached perspective.

label: Live Update
description: A live update is a series of brief reports from journalists on the ground while news is happening.

label: Feature
description: A feature is a longer story about people or systems with long-term or widespread relevance, written from a reporter's perspective.

label: Profile
description: A profile tells the stories of individuals and their worldviews, written from a repoter's perspective.

label: Q&A
description: A Q&A is a transcription of a conversation between an interviewee and The Ubyssey, edited by our journalists for length and clarity.

label: Review
description: A review is a story about art or culture, written from a critical perspective.

label: Game Analysis
description: A game analysis is a story about individual games, written from an reporter's perspective.

label: Commentary
description: A commentary is a story that take a position on an event or topic relevant to the sport, and suggest a course of action, either in future or past-tense.

label: Essay
description: An opinion essay refers to author's views on the news, written from their own perspective but based on reporting.

label: Column
description: A column is a story reported by a columnists — an opinion journalists who makes abstract judgments about the news and the way the world should be.

label: Editorial
description: An n editorial is an opinion essay by the Editorial Board, the body of the newspaper's staff who debate and decide positions on the news of the day.

label: Letter to the Editor
description: A letter to the editor is a 250-word response to stories published in The Ubyssey, written by readers.

label: Letter from the Editor
description: A letter from the editor is a message to readers from the The Ubyssey's Senior Masthead.

label: Public Service Announcement
description: A public service announcement shares public interest information with imminent relevance, such as extreme weather or threats to public safety.

label: Other
description: Editors must seek approval from the senior masthead before publishing an 'other' story type.
